summary: The Timothy Files is a 1987 bestselling work of fiction by Lawrence Sanders consisting of linked stories. It follows Timothy Cone, a scruffy, hard-boiled investigator who is rough in manner but pure of heart. Cone struggles in relationships, including a rough-edged affair with his supervisor and a slightly softer bond with his cat Cleo, while his stories center on uncovering the truth and putting villains behind bars.
